articles.title_en: Optimal design of exchange water networks with control inputs in Eco-Industrial Parks
articles.title_cn: 生态工业园区中带控制输入的水交换网络优化设计
articles.abstract_en: Industrial water conservation is an important adaptation to preserve the environment. Eco-Industrial Parks (EIPs) have been designed to encourage the establishment of water exchange networks between enterprises in order to minimize freshwater consumption and wastewater discharge by maximizing wastewater reuse. In this paper, a mathematical programming model for designing and optimizing industrial water networks in EIPs is studied by formulating and solving Single-Leader–Multi-Follower (SLMF) game problems. Enterprises (followers) aim to minimize their operating costs by reusing wastewater from other enterprises, while the designer (leader) aims to minimize the consumption of natural resources within the ecopark. Moreover, when participating in the ecopark, enterprises can control all their input fluxes and the designer guarantees a minimal relative improvement in comparison with the stand-alone operation of each enterprise. The SLMF game is transformed into a single mixed-integer optimization problem. The obtained results are compared with the results of the blind-input model (Salas et al., 2020).
articles.abstract_cn: 工业节水是保护环境的重要适应措施。生态工业园区（EIPs）旨在鼓励企业之间建立水交换网络，通过最大化废水回用来最小化淡水消耗和废水排放。本文通过构建并求解单领导者-多跟随者（SLMF）博弈问题，研究了一种用于设计和优化EIPs中工业水网络的数学规划模型。企业（跟随者）旨在通过回用其他企业的废水来最小化其运营成本，而设计者（领导者）旨在最小化生态园区内自然资源的消耗。此外，当企业参与生态园区时，企业可以控制其所有输入通量，设计者保证与每个企业独立运营相比有最小的相对改进。SLMF博弈被转化为一个单一的混合整数优化问题。所得结果与盲输入模型（Salas等人，2020）的结果进行了比较。

articles.title_en: The role of electricity tariff design in distributed energy resource deployment
articles.title_cn: 电价设计在分布式能源部署中的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper simulates the effect of more advanced residential electricity tariffs on household adoption of distributed energy resources (DERs). We employ an end-user DER investment and operational engineering optimization model, and adapt it to include an economic utility function, calibrated to the observed hourly residential electricity consumption data from 2016 in the Commonwealth Edison service territory in Chicago, in order to represent household-level preferences for electricity consumption. We simulate the effect of a spectrum of electricity tariffs, from the status quo flat volumetric tariffs to more sophisticated tariffs that are reflective of electricity generation and distribution system costs. We find that tariffs that are more time variant lead to greater adoption of DERs, helping further reduce peak demands above and beyond the reductions that are achieved through shifts in consumption. Regarding the effect of electricity tariff design on DER investments, we find that given DER purchase costs in 2016, investments in rooftop photovoltaic (PV) and batteries are not privately optimal under any of our tariff design scenarios based on 2016 cost levels for electricity and gas in the Chicago study area. However, with continued reductions in PV technology costs, rooftop PV may see a greater adoption rate under some of the more cost-reflective tariffs. We also demonstrate a greater incentive to invest in electrification of household space heating in the form of heat pumps under cost-reflective tariffs. These findings provide insights on electricity tariff design and the role of DERs in the future decarbonized electricity system, and highlight the need to consider region-specific costs and conditions when analyzing the effects of electric tariff reform.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文模拟了更先进的居民电价对家庭采用分布式能源（DERs）的影响。我们采用了一个终端用户DER投资和运营工程优化模型，并对其进行调整以纳入经济效用函数，该函数根据芝加哥联邦爱迪生服务区域2016年观测到的每小时居民用电数据进行校准，以代表家庭对电力消费的偏好。我们模拟了一系列电价的影响，从现状的固定容量电价到更能反映发电和配电系统成本的更复杂的电价。我们发现，更具时间变化性的电价会导致DERs的更大采用，有助于进一步降低峰值需求，这超出了通过消费转移所实现的削减。关于电价设计对DER投资的影响，我们发现，鉴于2016年的DER购买成本，在基于芝加哥研究区域2016年电力和天然气成本水平的任何电价设计情景下，屋顶光伏（PV）和电池的投资都不是私人最优的。然而，随着PV技术成本的持续下降，在一些更能反映成本的电价下，屋顶PV的采用率可能会更高。我们还证明了在反映成本的电价下，以热泵形式进行家庭空间供暖电气化投资的更大激励。这些发现为电价设计和DERs在未来脱碳电力系统中的作用提供了见解，并强调了在分析电价改革影响时考虑区域特定成本和条件的必要性。

articles.title_en: Identifying key elements for adequate simplifications of investment choices – The case of wind energy expansion
articles.title_cn: 识别投资选择充分简化的关键要素——以风能扩张为例
articles.abstract_en: The analysis of future energy systems with increasing shares of renewable energy production poses various challenges to the models used in the field of energy system analysis. Aggregation is one solution to reduce the computation time of large optimisation problems, especially for optimisation models with endogenous capacity expansion. Since the economic viability of renewable investments is not directly driven by physical and technical characteristics but rather by the corresponding revenue and cost streams, we propose a novel aggregation method. Our framework covers both the spatial and the technological dimensions of wind investment choices—that is, siting and turbine choice. We define four value components related to, for example, the total yield or the site-specific infeed profile of investment choices. A clustering approach is applied to these value components to identify groups of investment choices that can be aggregated without excessive loss of accuracy. The scheme is applied in a case study of the German electricity system, and the influence of the different value components on the combined technological and spatial aggregation is analysed.
articles.abstract_cn: 对未来可再生能源生产份额不断增加的能源系统的分析，对能源系统分析领域所使用的模型提出了各种挑战。聚合是减少大型优化问题计算时间的一种解决方案，特别是对于具有内生容量扩张的优化模型。由于可再生投资的经济可行性并非直接由物理和技术特性驱动，而是由相应的收入和成本流驱动，我们提出了一种新颖的聚合方法。我们的框架涵盖了风电投资选择的空间和技术维度，即选址和涡轮机选择。我们定义了与投资选择的总产量或特定场址的馈电曲线等相关的四个价值组成部分。对这些价值组成部分应用聚类方法，以识别可以在不损失过多精度的情况下进行聚合的投资选择组。该方案在德国电力系统的案例研究中得到应用，并分析了不同价值组成部分对技术和空间聚合组合的影响。

articles.title_en: Joint optimization of sales-mix and generation plan for a large electricity producer
articles.title_cn: 大型电力生产商的销售组合与发电计划联合优化
articles.abstract_en: The paper develops a typical management problem of a large power producer (i.e., he can partly influence the market price). In particular, he routinely needs to decide how much of his generation it is preferable to commit to fixed-price bilateral contracts (e.g., futures) or to the spot market. However, he also needs to plan how to distribute the production between the different plants under his control. The two decisions, namely the sales-mix and the generation plan, naturally interact since the opportunity to influence the spot price depends, among other things, on the amount of the energy that the producer directs on the spot market. We develop a risk management problem, since we consider an optimization problem combining a trade-off between expectation and conditional value at risk of the profit function of the producer. The sources of uncertainty are relatively large and include demand, renewables generation, and the fuel costs of conventional plants. We also endogenously model the price of futures in a way that reflects an information advantage of a large power producer. In particular, it is assumed that the market forecasts the price of futures in a naive way, namely not anticipating the impact of the large producer on the spot market. The paper provides a MILP formulation of the problem and analyzes the solution through a simulation based on data from the Spanish power market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个大型电力生产商（即能够部分影响市场价格）的典型管理问题。具体而言，他需要定期决定将其发电量中的多少用于固定价格双边合同（如期货）或现货市场。然而，他还需要规划如何在其控制下的不同电厂之间分配生产。这两个决策，即销售组合和发电计划，自然相互作用，因为影响现货价格的机会除其他因素外取决于生产商在现货市场上投放的能源量。我们构建了一个风险管理问题，因为我们考虑了一个优化问题，该问题结合了生产商利润函数的期望与条件风险价值之间的权衡。不确定性的来源相对较多，包括需求、可再生能源发电以及常规电厂的燃料成本。我们还以内生方式对期货价格进行建模，以反映大型电力生产商的信息优势。特别是，假设市场以天真的方式预测期货价格，即不预期大型生产商对现货市场的影响。本文提供了该问题的混合整数线性规划（MILP）公式，并基于西班牙电力市场的数据通过模拟分析了解决方案。

articles.title_en: Convenience yield risk
articles.title_cn: 便利收益风险
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework to quantify the convenience yield risk (CYR) inherent to each commodity futures market. Implementing our approach, we document that our novel CYR measure is informative about future commodity returns. In panel regressions, the CYR predicts future returns with a positive sign. Economically, a strategy that opens long positions in commodity markets with a higher than median CYR signal and sells the remaining commodities yields an average return of 6.93% per year. The performance of the CYR strategy cannot be explained by exposure to existing commodity strategies or other variables that capture changes in the investment opportunity set.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架来量化每个商品期货市场固有的便利收益风险（CYR）。通过实施我们的方法，我们证明了我们的新型CYR指标对未来商品收益具有信息性。在面板回归中，CYR以正号预测未来收益。从经济角度看，一种在CYR信号高于中位数的商品市场开多头头寸并卖出其余商品的策略，每年平均收益为6.93%。CYR策略的表现无法用现有商品策略或其他捕捉投资机会集变化的变量的敞口来解释。

articles.title_en: Stranded houses? The price effect of a minimum energy efficiency standard
articles.title_cn: 搁浅的房屋？最低能效标准的价格效应
articles.abstract_en: Climate policies aimed at reducing greenhouse gas emissions can lead to decreases in the values of assets, risking them to become “stranded”. We study the price effects of the introduction of a specific climate policy, a minimum energy efficiency standard, in the housing market. Leveraging a unique data set of the population of all residential house transactions in England and Wales, we show that prices of energy-inefficient properties affected by this policy decreased on average by about £5k to £9k relative to efficient ones. We interpret this evidence as being consistent with semi-strong market efficiency in the housing market.
articles.abstract_cn: 旨在减少温室气体排放的气候政策可能导致资产价值下降，使其面临“搁浅”风险。我们研究了在住房市场中引入一项特定气候政策——最低能效标准——的价格效应。利用英格兰和威尔士所有住宅交易总体的独特数据集，我们表明，受该政策影响的能效低下的房产价格相对于能效高的房产平均下降了约5000千至9000千英镑。我们将这一证据解释为与住房市场的半强式市场有效性一致。

articles.title_en: The environmental Kuznets curve reconsidered
articles.title_cn: 环境库兹涅茨曲线再思考
articles.abstract_en: The environmental Kuznets curve (EKC) hypothesis, whereby pollution first increases then decreases as income increases along an inverted U-shaped path, has generated a large literature beginning in the 1990s. The current analysis contributes to that literature in two main ways, one theoretical and one empirical. First, the theoretical inquiry begins with the idea that a variety of societal parameters may significantly impact the trajectory of environmental quality. We show that changes to production and consumption elasticity can be used to identify the environmental impact of changes to any of these parameters. Special attention is devoted to the cases of income and population growth as each is widely recognized as commanding significant influence over environmental quality. We find that for a wide class of constant elasticity of substitution (CES) models (where production technology and consumer preferences are both in a CES form) both income and population growth lead to degradation of environmental quality along an inverted U-shaped path. This common feature is due to the fact that both income and population have the same relative impact (in their unbounded limits) on production and consumption elasticity. Second, a large new dataset for 1789 sites over 38 years is assembled making it possible to overcome data shortcomings in earlier studies. When integrating the theoretical insights for population change into the empirical model formulation, our results find robust inverted U-shaped relationships for air pollutants with rising incomes and rising population density. These findings provide some added perspective on the claims and implications for the EKC literature and expectations about the possible decoupling of economic growth and environmental damages.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）假说认为，污染随着收入增加先上升后下降，呈倒U形路径，自1990年以来产生了大量文献。当前分析在理论和实证两个主要方面对该文献做出贡献。首先，理论探究始于这样一种观点：各种社会参数可能显著影响环境质量的轨迹。我们表明，生产和消费弹性的变化可用于识别任何这些参数变化的环境影响。特别关注收入和人口增长的情况，因为两者被广泛认为对环境质量具有显著影响。我们发现，对于一大类恒定替代弹性（CES）模型（其中生产技术 and 消费者偏好均呈CES形式），收入和人口增长都导致环境质量沿倒U形路径退化。这一共同特征源于收入和人口在生产与消费弹性上具有相同的相对影响（在其无界极限中）。其次，汇编了一个涵盖1789个地点、跨越38年的大型新数据集，从而能够克服早期研究中的数据不足。在将人口变化的理论见解整合到实证模型公式中时，我们的结果发现空气污染物与收入上升和人口密度上升之间存在稳健的倒U形关系。这些发现为EKC文献的主张和含义，以及关于经济增长与环境损害可能脱钩的预期，提供了一些额外的视角。

articles.title_en: Identifying optimal capacity expansion and differentiated capacity payments under risk aversion and market power: A financial Stackelberg game approach
articles.title_cn: 风险厌恶与市场势力下最优容量扩张与差异化容量支付：一种金融斯塔克尔伯格博弈方法
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how capacity payments in combination with scarcity pricing of energy can ensure resource adequacy in electricity markets, defined as the ability of supply and other resources to provide enough energy and capacity to meet demand under steady-state operating conditions. This work generalizes models for determining capacity payments by deriving second-best discriminatory payments by resource type that account not only for the “missing money” market failure that arises from energy price caps, but also for market power in the capacity market and differences in risk tolerance among resource types that can arise from failures in risk and capital markets. A bi-level equilibrium-constrained optimization model is proposed to define second-best capacity payments in a static long-run setting, considering the impacts of those payments on the mix and cost of generation investment and energy outputs. The lower-level suppliers play a Nash game to determine the generation mix under a capacity payment scheme, while the upper-level regulator considers consumer welfare and resource adequacy. We introduce an equivalent formulation via a variational inequality approach, and find conditions for the solution to exist. Discriminatory payments are found to be second-best when there are market power in the investment game, price caps in energy markets and imperfections in risk markets that lead to diverse risk attitudes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了容量支付与能源稀缺定价相结合如何确保电力市场中的资源充足性，即供应和其他资源在稳态运行条件下提供足够能源和容量以满足需求的能力。本研究通过推导按资源类型划分的次优歧视性支付，推广了确定容量支付的模型，这些支付不仅考虑了由能源价格上限引起的“缺失资金”市场失灵，还考虑了容量市场中的市场势力以及因风险市场和资本市场失灵而可能产生的资源类型间风险容忍度差异。提出了一个双层均衡约束优化模型，在静态长期环境中定义次优容量支付，考虑这些支付对发电投资组合和能源产出的影响。下层供应商在容量支付方案下进行纳什博弈以确定发电组合，而上层监管机构则考虑消费者福利和资源充足性。我们通过变分不等式方法引入等价公式，并找到了解存在的条件。当投资博弈中存在市场势力、能源市场存在价格上限以及风险市场存在导致不同风险态度的不完善时，歧视性支付被认为是次优的。

articles.title_en: Stringent environmental regulation and inconsistent green innovation behavior: Evidence from air pollution prevention and control action plan in China
articles.title_cn: 严格的环境规制与不一致的绿色创新行为：来自中国大气污染防治行动计划的证据
articles.abstract_en: Air Pollution Prevention and Control Action Plan (APPCAP), which was introduced in 2013, had been hailed as the most stringent policy for air pollution control in China. In this paper, we evaluate the impact of APPCAP on the green innovation behavior of listed companies by adopting the difference-in-difference (DID) identification technique. And three innovation indicators (quantity, quality, and diversity) are constructed based on the green invention patent data in China during 2008–2017. We find that stricter emission reduction targets will induce listed companies to increase the applications for green inventions. Mechanism analysis further proves that financial resources are essential to promote green innovation under the pressure of air pollution control. And broadening financing channels as well as the support of government subsidies accompanied by the implementation of APPCAP would raise the enthusiasm of listed companies to invent. Specifically, state-owned companies and non-innovators, which are both sensitive to the government's decisions, are proven to be responsible for the rapid growth of green invention applications. Furthermore, we find that the companies' green innovation behavior is inconsistent. APPCAP will enhance the green innovation diversity, but does not improve the quality.
articles.abstract_cn: 大气污染防治行动计划（APPCAP）于2013年出台，被誉为中国最严格的空气污染控制政策。本文采用双重差分（DID）识别技术，评估APPCAP对上市公司绿色创新行为的影响。基于2008-2017年中国绿色发明专利数据，构建了三个创新指标（数量、质量和多样性）。我们发现，更严格的减排目标将促使上市公司增加绿色发明申请。机制分析进一步证明，在空气污染控制压力下，财政资源对于促进绿色创新至关重要。拓宽融资渠道以及伴随APPCAP实施的政府补贴支持，将提高上市公司发明的积极性。具体而言，国有企业和非创新型企业，两者都对政府决策敏感，被证明是绿色发明申请快速增长的原因。此外，我们发现企业的绿色创新行为是不一致的。APPCAP将增强绿色创新的多样性，但并未提高质量。

articles.title_en: Nexus between digital transformation and energy technology innovation: An empirical test of A-share listed enterprises
articles.title_cn: 数字化转型与能源技术创新的关系：基于A股上市企业的实证检验
articles.abstract_en: In the era of digital economy, the economic model combining “substantial economy” and “digitalization” has spurred China's innovation activities, in particular energy technology innovation (ETI), with digital transformation (DT) becoming necessary for enterprises to stay competitive. However, how DT contributes to ETI remains unclear in both literature and practice. Recognizing their importance in ultimately sustaining enterprises' competitiveness, in this study we explore the nexus and mechanism between enterprise DT and ETI. In our research methodology, the data collected pertains to 1747 enterprises listed in A-shares from 2011 to 2019. We develop both static and dynamic benchmark regression models and a moderation effect model to test the relationships between DT and ETI. In addition, to address the endogeneity issue in model application, we introduce exogenous instrumental variables and adopt the generalized method of moment and a two-stage least square method. Our findings highlight that DT has not only a positive impact on ETI but also a heterogeneous effect on ETI in the types of enterprise ownerships and bias of energy technology progress. Moreover, it affects ETI mainly through total agency costs, financial technology, and research and development investment. Based on the findings, we offer policy recommendations for the coordination of digital economy and energy transition, providing guidance for developing countries. For example, digital platforms are recommended to be implemented at both the enterprise and national levels, in attempting to facilitate the development of digital economy and smart energy.
articles.abstract_cn: 在数字经济时代，“实体经济”与“数字化”相结合的经济模式激发了中国创新活动，特别是能源技术创新（ETI），数字化转型（DT）已成为企业保持竞争力的必要条件。然而，DT如何促进ETI在文献和实践中仍不清楚。认识到它们最终维持企业竞争力的重要性，本研究探讨了企业DT与ETI之间的关系和机制。在研究方法上，收集的数据涉及2011年至2019年A股上市的1747家企业。我们建立了静态和动态基准回归模型以及调节效应模型来检验DT与ETI之间的关系。此外，为解决模型应用中的内生性问题，我们引入了外生工具变量，并采用广义矩估计和两阶段最小二乘法。我们的研究结果表明，DT不仅对ETI有积极影响，而且对企业所有权类型和能源技术进步偏向的ETI具有异质性效应。此外，它主要通过总代理成本、金融技术和研发投资影响ETI。基于研究结果，我们为数字经济与能源转型的协调提供了政策建议，为发展中国家提供指导。例如，建议在企业层面和国家层面实施数字平台，以促进数字经济和智慧能源的发展。

articles.title_en: Do green and dirty investments hedge each other?
articles.title_cn: 绿色投资与肮脏投资能否相互对冲？
articles.abstract_en: To augment the relative prices of carbon content emeries to green energies, many governments have imposed carbon prices and proved subsidies to green energy production. Given the imperative role of green finance for global energy transitions, we investigate whether oil equity transmits any significant signal to green investments and vice-versa as substitute commodities. To this end, we apply three novel time-series methods; namely, the Cross-Quantilogram, Time-frequency connectedness and Cross-spectral quantile coherency approaches to analyze daily return series of green bonds, green equity, and selected oil companies' equity returns as dirty investments ranging 30th August 2014 till 9th November 2021. Our empirical investigation demonstrates that dirty investments (oil equity) transmit negative volatility spillovers to green investments (both bond and equity). On the contrary, dirty investment returns respond positively to both green bonds and green equity returns. The co-movement between green and dirty markets is more pronounced in the short time. We also confirm that oil equities induce higher volatility on green markets than vice versa, with green bonds being more vulnerable to this impact. The paper provides policy implications for investors' decision-making making process on risk hedging.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了提升含碳能源相对于绿色能源的相对价格，许多政府已对碳排放定价，并对绿色能源生产提供补贴。鉴于绿色金融在全球能源转型中的关键作用，我们研究了石油股票是否向绿色投资传递显著信号，反之亦然，作为替代商品。为此，我们应用三种新颖的时间序列方法，即交叉分位数图、时频连通性和交叉谱分位数相干性方法，分析绿色债券、绿色股票以及选定石油公司股票收益（作为肮脏投资）的日收益序列，时间范围从2014年八月30日至2021年十一月9日。我们的实证研究表明，肮脏投资（石油股票）向绿色投资（债券和股票）传递负向波动溢出。相反，肮脏投资回报对绿色债券和绿色股票回报均呈正向响应。绿色与肮脏市场之间的联动在短期内更为显著。我们还确认，石油股票对绿色市场产生的波动性影响大于反向影响，其中绿色债券更容易受到这种影响。本文为投资者在风险对冲决策过程中提供了政策启示。

articles.title_en: Warmer temperatures and energy poverty: Evidence from Chinese households
articles.title_cn: 气温升高与能源贫困：来自中国家庭的证据
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the casual effect of warmer temperatures on energy poverty in China using a nationally representative household survey from 2014 to 2018. Exploiting daily mean temperatures over the 12 months preceding the interview, we find that warmer temperatures increase energy poverty at the intensive and extensive margins. We find evidence of seasonal effects and that it is unusually warmer springs, rather than hotter summers, that are responsible for our results. We decompose the energy poverty result into the effect of temperature on energy expenditure and the effect of temperature on income. Our results suggest that both channels operate via heat stress, but not cold stress, and that the income channel is relatively more important. We show that one reason why warmer temperatures increase expenditure on energy is that on hotter days households shift leisure activities inside in order to cope with heat stress; hence, consuming more energy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用2014年至2018年具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据，估计了气温升高对中国能源贫困的因果效应。利用访谈前12个月的日平均气温，我们发现气温升高在集约边际和广延边际上增加了能源贫困。我们发现了季节性效应的证据，并且是异常温暖的春季，而非更炎热的夏季，导致了我们的结果。我们将能源贫困的结果分解为气温对能源支出的影响和气温对收入的影响。我们的结果表明，这两个渠道都通过热应激而非冷应激起作用，且收入渠道相对更为重要。我们表明，气温升高导致能源支出增加的一个原因是，在更热的日子里，家庭将休闲活动转移到室内以应对热应激；因此，消耗了更多能源。

articles.title_en: Energy efficiency as a sustainability concern in Africa and financial development: How much bias is involved?
articles.title_cn: 非洲能源效率作为可持续性关切与金融发展：涉及多少偏差？
articles.abstract_en: This study contributes to the literature on whether financial development stimulates technical energy efficiency (TEE) or not, by addressing core biases that creep into the relationship and thereby reducing the ability to draw causal inferences from financial development to TEE. Our approach is based on the instrumental stochastic frontier technique, where biases in the frontier and inefficiency equations are dealt with using external instrumental variables. The legal system origin of the country and life expectancy at birth were used as instruments for financial development and income, respectively. The current study demonstrates substantial bias in income elasticity, the estimate of energy efficiency, and the effect of financial development on energy efficiency. Both income elasticity and energy efficiency estimate risk upward bias. Equally, the effect of financial system development and financial institution development on TEE risk downward bias. Other results show that all aspects of financial institution development stimulate TEE, but access to financial institutions is more important. These results raise caution about future studies' estimates of the effect of financial development on TEE. Though this study has demonstrated the potency of external instruments in dealing with the bias in the coefficient estimates, we consider this might prove to be a luxury solution in some cases due to data limitation, context differences, and theory. In those circumstances, reliance on internal instruments might prove to be the second-best option.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究通过解决金融发展与技术能源效率（TEE）关系中渗入的核心偏差，从而削弱从金融发展到TEE进行因果推断的能力，为关于金融发展是否促进技术能源效率的文献做出贡献。我们的方法基于工具随机前沿技术，其中前沿和无效率方程中的偏差通过使用外部工具变量来处理。国家的法律体系起源和出生时预期寿命分别被用作金融发展和收入的工具。当前研究展示了收入弹性、能源效率估计以及金融发展对能源效率影响中的显著偏差。收入弹性和能源效率估计均存在向上偏差的风险。同样，金融体系发展和金融机构发展对TEE的影响存在向下偏差的风险。其他结果表明，金融机构发展的所有方面都刺激了TEE，但金融机构的获取更为重要。这些结果对未来研究中金融发展对TEE影响的估计提出了警示。尽管本研究证明了外部工具在处理系数估计偏差方面的效力，但我们认为由于数据限制、背景差异和理论，在某些情况下这可能是一种奢侈的解决方案。在这些情况下，依赖内部工具可能是次优选择。

articles.title_en: Introduction of the carbon tax in Italy: Is there room for a quadruple-dividend effect?
articles.title_cn: 意大利引入碳税：是否存在四重红利效应的空间？
articles.abstract_en: This study seeks to examine the environmental and societal impacts of a carbon tax in Italy, where the policy has yet to be implemented but has been the subject of much debate. We use numerical simulations based on the EUROGREEN macro-system dynamic model (D’Alessandro et al., 2020) to evaluate the potential benefits and drawbacks of this policy from 2010 to 2050.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在考察意大利碳税的环境和社会影响，该政策尚未实施但一直是争论的焦点。我们使用基于EUROGREEN宏观系统动态模型（D’Alessandro等，2020）的数值模拟，评估该政策从2010年到2050年的潜在利弊。

articles.title_en: Internal mechanism analysis of the financial vanishing effect on green growth: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 金融消失效应对绿色增长的内在机制分析：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using the panel data of 30 provinces in China from 2011 to 2018, this study examines the nonlinear relationship between financial development and green growth, as well as its internal generation mechanism by employing the Ordinary Least Square (OLS) method, Two-stage Least Squares (TSLS) method, System Two-step Generalized method of moments (System Two-step GMM) and dynamic panel threshold model of Seo et al. (2019). The empirical results reveal that, firstly, the scale of financial institutions (FDS) significantly inhibits green growth (GG), while the scale of the stock market (STO) significantly promotes green growth (GG). Secondly, there is a nonlinear relationship between financial development and green growth. There is an inverted U-shaped nonlinear relationship between the scale of financial institutions (FDS) and green growth (GG). That means when the ratio of the comprehensive level of financial development (FDCI) to the comprehensive level of technological innovation (TICI) is lower than a certain threshold, the development scale of financial institutions (FDS) will significantly promote green growth (GG). However, the scale of the stock market (STO) and green growth (GG) show an opposite linear relationship. This study proves that the financial vanishing effect differs in different proportions of the comprehensive level of financial development (FDCI) and the comprehensive level of technological innovation (TICI). This study also analyzes the differences between the impacts of technological innovation (TI) and green technology innovation (GI) on the financial vanishing effect. In addition, compared with the underdeveloped western regions, the scale of financial institutions (FDS) in the more developed eastern and central regions has a stronger inhibitory effect on green growth. Compared with the economically developed eastern and central regions, the scale of the stock market (STO) in the economically underdeveloped western regions has a stronger role in promoting green growth. Finally, financial development can affect green growth by affecting capital misallocation (ABK) and energy intensity (EDS). This study provides new policy suggestions for the country to improve the financial system reform and optimize the financial market structure. This study also offers a reference for policy makers to formulate financial risk early warning mechanisms and avoid the financial vanishing effects. In short, this study provides new evidence for the green development of China's economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用2011年至2018年中国30个省份的面板数据，本研究通过普通最小二乘法（OLS）、两阶段最小二乘法（TSLS）、系统两步广义矩估计（System Two-step GMM）以及Seo等人（2019）的动态面板门槛模型，考察了金融发展与绿色增长之间的非线性关系及其内在生成机制。实证结果表明：首先，金融机构规模（FDS）显著抑制绿色增长（GG），而股票市场规模（STO）显著促进绿色增长（GG）。其次，金融发展与绿色增长之间存在非线性关系。金融机构规模（FDS）与绿色增长（GG）之间存在倒U型非线性关系。这意味着当金融发展综合水平（FDCI）与技术创新综合水平（TICI）的比率低于某一门槛值时，金融机构发展规模（FDS）将显著促进绿色增长（GG）。然而，股票市场规模（STO）与绿色增长（GG）呈现相反的线性关系。本研究证明，金融消失效应在金融发展综合水平（FDCI）与技术创新综合水平（TICI）的不同比例下存在差异。本研究还分析了技术创新（TI）和绿色技术创新（GI）对金融消失效应影响的差异。此外，与欠发达的西部地区相比，较发达的东部和中部地区的金融机构规模（FDS）对绿色增长的抑制作用更强。与经济发达的东部和中部地区相比，经济欠发达的西部地区的股票市场规模（STO）对绿色增长的促进作用更强。最后，金融发展可以通过影响资本错配（ABK）和能源强度（EDS）来影响绿色增长。本研究为国家完善金融体系改革和优化金融市场结构提供了新的政策建议。本研究也为政策制定者制定金融风险预警机制和避免金融消失效应提供了参考。总之，本研究为中国经济的绿色发展提供了新的证据。

articles.title_en: Does the carbon emissions trading system reduce carbon emissions by promoting two-way FDI in developing countries? Evidence from Chinese listed companies and cities
articles.title_cn: 碳排放交易体系是否通过促进双向外国直接投资减少发展中国家的碳排放？来自中国上市公司和城市的证据
articles.abstract_en: How developing countries can effectively promote cities’ carbon emission reduction through the carbon emission trading system (ETS) is a topic worthy of attention in the global carbon reduction campaign. Policy changes in China’s ETS provide a unique opportunity to measure whether ETS impacts carbon emissions through two-way FDI. Hence, this paper employs difference-in-differences (DID) method to test the causal impact of ETS pilot policy on emissions through two-way FDI. The specific results are shown below. We find that the ETS pilot policy’s emission reduction policy significantly inhibited pilot cities’ carbon emissions through two-way FDI. The emission reduction effect is evident in cities with higher administrative levels, better location advantages, and a higher degree of nationalization and energy demand. The mechanism test shows that ETS positively impacts urban carbon emission reduction through the scale, industrial structure, and technical effects of two-way FDI. Among them, the positive effects of technical effect and scale effect are relatively large. The conclusion of this study provides policy enlightenment for giving full play to the carbon reduction effect of the ETS policy. At the same time, it provides experience reference for other developing countries to design ETS for carbon emission control in opening to the outside world.
articles.abstract_cn: 发展中国家如何通过碳排放交易体系（ETS）有效促进城市碳减排，是全球碳减排行动中值得关注的话题。中国ETS的政策变化为衡量ETS是否通过双向外国直接投资影响碳排放提供了独特的机会。因此，本文采用双重差分（DID）方法检验ETS试点政策通过双向外国直接投资对碳排放的因果影响。具体结果如下。我们发现，ETS试点政策的减排政策通过双向外国直接投资显著抑制了试点城市的碳排放。减排效应在行政级别较高、区位优势较好、国有化程度和能源需求较高的城市中尤为明显。机制检验表明，ETS通过双向外国直接投资的规模效应、产业结构效应和技术效应正向促进城市碳减排。其中，技术效应和规模效应的正向作用相对较大。本研究的结论为充分发挥ETS政策的碳减排效应提供了政策启示。同时，为其他发展中国家在对外开放中设计ETS以控制碳排放提供了经验参考。

articles.title_en: Dynamics of renewable energy research, investment in EnvoTech and environmental quality in the context of G7 countries
articles.title_cn: G7国家背景下可再生能源研究、环境技术投资与环境质量的动态关系
articles.abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to investigate the influence of renewable energy research and development (R&D) investment and the environment-related technological innovations, on the quality of the environment of the G7 economies over a period spanning from 1990 to 2020. The role of economic growth, R&D, and human capital has also been examined. For this very purpose, Panel data approaches, such as slope heterogeneity and cross-section dependence, have been used. All the variables taken into account are found in the long run cointegration association. The study also uses the novel Method of Moment Quantile Regression to determine the individual impact of each variable. The examined results have asserted that economic growth and human capital are positively associated with carbon emissions. Whereas the development of environment related technologies significantly reduce the level of emissions. On the other hand, R&D and renewable energy R&D exhibit a U-shaped influence on carbon emissions. The Dumitrescu and Hurlin Granger panel causality test reveals a bidirectional causal association of carbon and all the other variables taken into consideration. These results are found robust, as validated by the quantile regression. Based on the empirical results, this study suggests enhancing the financing efforts towards R&D, renewable energy R&D, and environment-related technological innovations, in order to attain environmental sustainability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在探讨1990年至2020年期间，可再生能源研发（R&D）投资和环境相关技术创新对G7经济体环境质量的影响。同时，也考察了经济增长、研发和人力资本的作用。为此，采用了面板数据方法，如斜率异质性和横截面依赖性检验。所考虑的所有变量均存在长期协整关系。研究还采用了新颖的分位数回归矩方法来确定每个变量的个体影响。研究结果表明，经济增长和人力资本与碳排放呈正相关。而环境相关技术的发展显著降低了排放水平。另一方面，研发和可再生能源研发对碳排放表现出U型影响。Dumitrescu和Hurlin格兰杰面板因果检验揭示了碳排放与所考虑的所有其他变量之间存在双向因果关系。这些结果通过分位数回归验证，具有稳健性。基于实证结果，本研究建议加大对研发、可再生能源研发和环境相关技术创新的融资力度，以实现环境可持续性。

articles.title_en: Energy-related financial literacy and retrofits of Soviet-era apartment buildings: The case of Lithuania
articles.title_cn: 能源相关金融素养与苏联时期公寓楼的翻新：立陶宛案例
articles.abstract_en: This paper extends the literature on energy-related financial literacy by examining its role in collective energy retrofit investment decisions in Soviet-era countries, which suffer from suboptimal levels of these investments, purportedly due to a lack of energy-specific knowledge and financial skills as well as low levels of trust. We investigate whether energy-related financial literacy and trust help explain collective energy retrofit investment decisions of typical Soviet-built multi-dwelling buildings in the case of Lithuania. Using unique survey data from Lithuania, we find that individuals' willingness to invest in multi-dwelling building energy retrofits is positively associated with individuals' general financial literacy, energy literacy, and energy-related financial literacy. Furthermore, we show that individuals' trust in institutions that are directly involved in the house-retrofitting process is an important predictor for multi-dwelling building energy retrofit decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过考察能源相关金融素养在苏联时期国家集体能源翻新投资决策中的作用，扩展了相关文献。这些国家的此类投资水平欠佳，据称是由于缺乏能源特定知识和金融技能以及信任度低。我们利用立陶宛的独特调查数据，研究能源相关金融素养和信任是否有助于解释典型的苏联建造的多户住宅楼的集体能源翻新投资决策。我们发现，个人对多户住宅楼能源翻新投资的意愿与个人的一般金融素养、能源素养和能源相关金融素养正相关。此外，我们表明，个人对直接参与房屋翻新过程的机构的信任是多户住宅楼能源翻新决策的重要预测因素。

articles.title_en: Interdependence of clean energy and green markets with cryptocurrencies
articles.title_cn: 清洁能源与绿色市场及加密货币的相互依存关系
articles.abstract_en: The adverse effects of the high-power energy consumption by cryptocurrencies on the environment and sustainability have raised the interest of a large body of policymakers and market participants. We apply a network approach to investigate the dependency across clean energy, green markets, and cryptocurrencies from 1 January 2018 to 30 November 2021. Our results indicate that sustainable investments, particularly DJSI and ESGL, play a pivotal role in the network system during the COVID-19 crisis. We find that green bonds are the least integrated with the other financial markets, suggesting their significant role in providing diversification benefits to investors. Rolling windows estimation shows that the dependency across the examined marked increased sharply during the COVID-19 crisis, especially between March 2020 and March 2021, after which it faded and became weak and stable until the end of the sample period. Results of the centrality network are consistent with the dependency network analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 加密货币高能耗对环境和可持续性的不利影响引起了众多政策制定者和市场参与者的关注。我们采用网络方法，研究了2018年一月1日至2021年十一月30日期间清洁能源、绿色市场与加密货币之间的依存关系。结果表明，在COVID-19危机期间，可持续投资，尤其是DJSI和ESGL，在网络系统中发挥了关键作用。我们发现绿色债券与其他金融市场的整合程度最低，表明其在为投资者提供多元化收益方面具有重要作用。滚动窗口估计显示，所考察市场之间的依存关系在COVID-19危机期间急剧增强，尤其是在2020年三月至2021年三月之间，此后逐渐减弱并趋于稳定，直至样本期结束。中心性网络的结果与依存性网络分析一致。

articles.title_en: Extreme climate, innovative ability and energy efficiency
articles.title_cn: 极端气候、创新能力与能源效率
articles.abstract_en: It is of great significance to explore the effect and mechanism of extreme climate on energy efficiency. In theory, extreme climate can stimulate the forcing effect to improve the level of innovation ability and energy efficiency in the long run. Empirically, this study measures the comprehensive level of extreme climate, innovation ability, and energy efficiency of 236 cities in China from 2011 to 2019 and then conducts econometric analysis. The results show that extreme climate significantly plays a forcing role for the improvement of energy efficiency. Innovation ability is also an important intermediary mechanism through which extreme climate influences energy efficiency. The impact of extreme climate on energy efficiency has significant regional heterogeneity, and the impact on peripheral cities is greater than that on core cities, showing the characteristics of a diminishing marginal effect. In order to better cope with extreme climate and improve energy efficiency, it is necessary to adhere to the combination of an effective market and promising government, increase financial investment in dealing with extreme climate, and promote energy transformation.
articles.abstract_cn: 探索极端气候对能源效率的影响及机制具有重要意义。理论上，极端气候可以激发倒逼效应，长期内提升创新能力和能源效率水平。实证上，本研究测度了2011年至2019年中国236个城市的极端气候、创新能力和能源效率的综合水平，并进行计量分析。结果表明，极端气候对能源效率的提升显著发挥了倒逼作用。创新能力也是极端气候影响能源效率的重要中介机制。极端气候对能源效率的影响存在显著的区域异质性，对边缘城市的影响大于核心城市，呈现出边际效应递减的特征。为了更好地应对极端气候并提高能源效率，有必要坚持有效市场与有为政府相结合，增加应对极端气候的财政投入，并推动能源转型。

articles.title_en: The beneficial role of green bonds as a new strategic asset class: Dynamic dependencies, allocation and diversification before and during the pandemic era
articles.title_cn: 绿色债券作为新型战略资产类别的有益作用：疫情前后及期间的动态依赖、配置与多元化
articles.abstract_en: The paper proposes a full comprehensive analysis of green bond diversification benefits, their co-movement with multiple market indices, and the corresponding implications for portfolio allocation. Based on a time frame of seven years, divided into four sub-periods, the co-movements of green-bond indices, i.e. Solactive Green Bond Index and Bloomberg Barclays MSCI Green Bond Index, and the stock/bond market have been described, shedding light on the connections with sectors most affected by the Covid-19 pandemic. The Solactive Green Bond Index is found to provide the greater diversification benefit of the two green-bond indices, on average during the seven years and also during the pandemic. Allocation strategies and risk performances have also been analyzed to assess the impact of green-bond indices on otherwise traditional portfolios; their diversification power is discussed by use of traditional measures and an additional behavioral approach, drawing attention to its evolution in time and its consistency in terms of diminished risks and increased returns. Portfolios constructed with the inclusion of green bonds prove preferable in terms of risk, in all periods and for all strategies, while the superiority of returns depends on the allocation strategy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文对绿色债券的多元化收益、其与多个市场指数的共同运动以及相应的投资组合配置影响进行了全面综合分析。基于七年时间框架，分为四个子时期，描述了绿色债券指数（即Solactive绿色债券指数和Bloomberg Barclays MSCI绿色债券指数）与股票/债券市场的共同运动，揭示了与受Covid-19疫情影响最严重行业的联系。研究发现，Solactive绿色债券指数在七年平均及疫情期间均提供了两个绿色债券指数中更大的多元化收益。本文还分析了配置策略和风险表现，以评估绿色债券指数对传统投资组合的影响；通过传统指标和额外的行为方法讨论其多元化能力，关注其随时间演变及其在降低风险和增加收益方面的一致性。在所有时期和所有策略中，包含绿色债券的投资组合在风险方面均表现更优，而收益的优越性则取决于配置策略。

articles.title_en: Cost-efficiency and quality regulation of energy network utilities
articles.title_cn: 能源网络公用事业的成本效率与质量监管
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies linear cost-efficiency and quality incentives that are increasingly being used to regulate electricity and gas network utilities. The analysis shows that cost and quality incentives have asymmetric impacts on firms’ choices of efficiency and quality, and that the incentive powers should be equal and less than maximal when there is information asymmetry about firm costs and a dislike for network utility surplus. As in most existing regulations quality incentives have a higher power than cost-efficiency incentives, the model predicts that supplied quality is too high. Finally, the paper discusses examples of linear sliding-scale incentive regulation in Norway and Great Britain. The findings of this study provide guidance for regulators and policymakers looking to optimally use linear incentives to regulate energy network utilities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了日益用于监管电力和燃气网络公用事业的线性成本效率与质量激励。分析表明，成本和质量激励对企业效率和质量的抉择具有不对称影响，并且在企业成本存在信息不对称且厌恶网络公用事业盈余的情况下，激励强度应相等且低于最大强度。由于大多数现有监管中质量激励的强度高于成本效率激励，模型预测供给质量过高。最后，本文讨论了挪威和英国线性滑动比例激励监管的实例。本研究结果为监管机构和政策制定者优化使用线性激励以监管能源网络公用事业提供了指导。

articles.title_en: Modeling final energy demand and the impacts of energy price reform in Saudi Arabia
articles.title_cn: 建模沙特阿拉伯的最终能源需求与能源价格改革的影响
articles.abstract_en: We model energy demand across five end-use sectors and 15 energy products in Saudi Arabia, generating comprehensive price and income elasticity estimates. Using the Structural Time Series Model, we demonstrate that the trends underlying energy demand are generally stochastic, underscoring the importance of using such models for estimating unbiased elasticities. Our estimates reveal that energy demand in Saudi Arabia is price inelastic in all cases and income inelastic in most cases, with industrial natural gas and electricity being the only exceptions. Nevertheless, we find extensive variation in the elasticities across sectors and energy products, highlighting the importance of using sector- and product-specific elasticity values and not assuming they are similar in the same country. We then use our estimated elasticities to conduct a welfare analysis of the energy price reforms implemented in 2016 and 2018. Our analysis reveals that the 2016 reform delivered a total annual welfare gain of 11.6 billion 2010 United States Dollars (USD) in 2016. Following the 2018 reform, the annual welfare gain increased to 17.0 billion 2010 USD in 2018. We also estimate the cumulative carbon dioxide emissions avoided between 2016 and 2018 due to energy price reform at 164 million tonnes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们对沙特阿拉伯五个终端使用部门和15种能源产品的能源需求进行建模，生成全面的价格和收入弹性估计。使用结构时间序列模型，我们证明了能源需求背后的趋势通常是随机的，强调了使用此类模型估计无偏弹性的重要性。我们的估计显示，沙特阿拉伯的能源需求在所有情况下都是价格无弹性的，在大多数情况下是收入无弹性的，工业天然气和电力是唯一的例外。然而，我们发现不同部门和能源产品之间的弹性存在广泛差异，强调了使用部门和产品特定弹性值的重要性，而不是假设在同一国家内它们是相似的。然后，我们使用估计的弹性对2016年和2018年实施的能源价格改革进行福利分析。我们的分析显示，2016年的改革在11.6年带来了总计2010亿美元的年度福利收益（以2016年美元计）。在2018年改革后，年度福利收益在17.0年增加到2010亿美元（以2018年美元计）。我们还估计，由于能源价格改革，2016年至2018年间累计避免的二氧化碳排放量为164亿吨。

articles.title_en: Stricter energy regulations and water consumption: Firm-level evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 更严格的能源法规和水消耗：来自中国的企业层面的证据
articles.abstract_en: Coordinating water and energy saving contributes to the sustainable development of China's industrial sector and alleviates the resource shortage risk. Taking the mandatory energy-saving targets outlined in the “11th Five Year Plan” as a quasi-natural experiment, in this study, the difference-in-differences strategy is employed to examine the real impact of stricter energy regulations on water consumption intensity. The results show that after strictly restricting energy input, the water consumption intensity of industrial enterprises has increased significantly. This result is reliable according to several robustness checks. The increased water consumption intensity caused by stricter energy regulations is particularly apparent in regions with high energy-saving targets, non-state-owned enterprises, large-scale enterprises, and high-energy consuming sub-sectors. The imposition of stricter energy regulations has not changed the input preference and substitution relationship between water and energy; therefore, it does not significantly impact the total water consumption of enterprises. However, the decline of energy input leads to an imbalanced factor input structure, which reduces the technical efficiency and output level. The total water input scale of enterprises has not been adjusted synchronously with the decreasing output level, resulting in an increase of consumed water per unit output.
articles.abstract_cn: 统筹节水和节能，有利于中国工业可持续发展，缓解资源短缺风险。本研究以“11五年规划”中的强制性节能目标作为准自然实验，采用双重差分策略来检验更严格的能源法规对用水强度的真实影响。结果表明，严格限制能源投入后，工业企业用水强度明显增加。根据多项稳健性检查，该结果是可靠的。能源监管趋严带来的用水强度增加在节能目标较高的地区、非国有企业、大型企业、高耗能行业尤为明显。更严格的能源监管并没有改变水与能源之间的投入偏好和替代关系；因此，对企业用水总量影响不显着。但能源投入下降导致要素投入结构失衡，技术效率和产出水平降低。企业总投入水规模没有与产量水平下降同步调整，导致单位产量耗水量增加。

articles.title_en: Forecasting the volatility of precious metals prices with global economic policy uncertainty in pre and during the COVID-19 period: Novel evidence from the GARCH-MIDAS approach
articles.title_cn: COVID-19前后全球经济政策不确定性对贵金属价格波动率的预测：基于GARCH-MIDAS方法的新证据
articles.abstract_en: Economic policy is a major determinant of investment and financial decisions; Moreover, prices of precious metals are highly influenced by any uncertainty recorded in the global economic policy. Therefore, the prime consideration of the authors is to assess how global economic policy uncertainty influences the volatility of precious metals prices; particularly “gold, palladium, platinum, and silver” in the pre and during the COVID-19 pandemic. This research analyzed the full sample period (the 1997–2022), pre-COVID period (1997–2019), and during the COVID period (2020−2022) to evaluate the impact during different sample periods. Therefore, the GARCH-MIDAS approach is employed at the data set of different frequencies, i.e., monthly data of GEPU and daily data of precious metals. The results reveal a significant nexus between global GEPU and precious metals price volatility. The findings infer that any uncertainty recorded in global economic policy escalate the price volatility of gold, palladium, platinum, and silver prices. The present study increments the existing literature and provides insights for future scholars, investors, and policymakers.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济政策是投资和金融决策的主要决定因素；此外，贵金属价格受到全球经济政策中任何不确定性的高度影响。因此，作者的首要考虑是评估全球经济政策不确定性如何影响贵金属价格波动率，特别是在COVID-19大流行之前和期间的金、钯、铂和银。本研究分析了全样本期（1997-2022）、COVID前时期（1997-2019）和COVID期间（2020-2022），以评估不同样本期的影响。因此，采用GARCH-MIDAS方法处理不同频率的数据集，即GEPU的月度数据和贵金属的日度数据。结果揭示了全球GEPU与贵金属价格波动率之间的显著关联。研究结果表明，全球经济政策中记录的任何不确定性都会加剧金、钯、铂和银的价格波动。本研究补充了现有文献，并为未来的学者、投资者和政策制定者提供了见解。

articles.title_en: Who benefits from the decentralised energy system (DES)? Evidence from Nepal’s micro-hydropower (MHP)
articles.title_cn: 谁从分散式能源系统（DES）中受益？来自尼泊尔微型水电（MHP）的证据
articles.abstract_en: In low-income countries, uneven access to clean energy poses a challenge to reducing socioeconomic inequalities across gender and disadvantaged groups. Development planners view the decentralised energy system (DES) as having the potential to help address this issue, because it provides electricity access in areas where the national electricity grid is not available. This study assesses whether the DES helps to reduce inequality and improve gender empowerment by focusing on the micro-hydropower (MHP) scheme, a form of DES adopted widely in Nepal, and studying its impact on educational attainments and employment outcomes by caste and gender. The results show that MHP improves educational outcomes and facilitates a labour shift from traditional agriculture to waged and salaried jobs. However, a disaggregated analysis shows that, while the educational outcome of access to MHP electricity is higher for women and lower caste individuals, the positive employment-related effects are inclined towards socially dominant groups such as males and upper caste individuals. This shows that, while the DES improves educational outcomes in general, complementary conditions may be necessary to achieve significant improvements in the employment of women and lower caste individuals.
articles.abstract_cn: 在低收入国家，清洁能源获取的不均衡对减少性别和弱势群体间的社会经济不平等构成挑战。发展规划者认为分散式能源系统（DES）有潜力帮助解决这一问题，因为它能在国家电网无法覆盖的地区提供电力接入。本研究通过聚焦尼泊尔广泛采用的微型水电（MHP）计划，评估DES是否有助于减少不平等和促进性别赋权，并研究其对不同种姓和性别的教育成就和就业结果的影响。结果表明，MHP改善了教育成果，并促进了劳动力从传统农业向有薪和受雇工作的转移。然而，分类分析显示，虽然MHP电力接入的教育成果对女性和低种姓个体更高，但积极的就业相关效应却倾向于社会主导群体，如男性和高种姓个体。这表明，尽管DES总体上改善了教育成果，但可能还需要补充条件才能实现女性和低种姓个体就业的显著改善。

articles.title_en: Analysis of the spillover effects between green economy, clean and dirty cryptocurrencies
articles.title_cn: 绿色经济、清洁与肮脏加密货币之间的溢出效应分析
articles.abstract_en: Cryptocurrencies have been widely used as financial instruments over the past decade. Given the development of the cryptocurrency market and the increasing awareness of greener and more energy-efficient tokens, their connection to the green economy has become a popular topic for understanding economic and policy issues. However, the literature still lacks clear evidence on how cryptocurrencies interact with green economy indicators. Therefore, this study examines the correlations and spillover relationships between green economy indices, five black cryptocurrencies, and five clean cryptocurrencies for the U.S., Euro, and Asian markets. To this end, it applies the novel quantile spillover index approach of Ando et al. (2018) to daily data from November 9, 2017, to April 4, 2022. The empirical results show that the overall linkage is stronger for green economy indices and clean cryptocurrencies than for dirty cryptocurrencies. Moreover, green economy indices show net receiving behavior, while cryptocurrencies' results differ across variables, quantiles, and time. In addition, a notable point for clean cryptocurrencies is 2020, which was the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. The overall spillover effect is very high for all quantiles for the three markets, especially for Asia. This outcome signifies the safe harbor property for diversification purposes of the green economy. The results presented in this study are important for investors, regulators and, policymakers, cryptocurrency founders as they seek to be financially integrated and develop a more sustainable business.
articles.abstract_cn: 过去十年中，加密货币已被广泛用作金融工具。鉴于加密货币市场的发展以及人们对更绿色、更节能代币的认识不断提高，其与绿色经济的联系已成为理解经济与政策问题的热门话题。然而，文献中仍缺乏关于加密货币如何与绿色经济指标相互作用的明确证据。因此，本研究考察了美国、欧元区和亚洲市场中绿色经济指数、五种肮脏加密货币和五种清洁加密货币之间的相关性和溢出关系。为此，本研究将Ando等人（2018）提出的新颖分位数溢出指数方法应用于从十一月 9，2017到四月 4，2022的日度数据。实证结果表明，绿色经济指数与清洁加密货币之间的总体关联性强于与肮脏加密货币之间的关联性。此外，绿色经济指数表现出净接收行为，而加密货币的结果因变量、分位数和时间而异。另外，对于清洁加密货币而言，一个值得注意的时间点是2020，即COVID-19大流行的开始。三个市场的所有分位数上的总体溢出效应都非常高，尤其是亚洲市场。这一结果意味着绿色经济在多元化目的上具有安全港属性。本研究呈现的结果对于投资者、监管机构、政策制定者以及寻求财务整合并发展更可持续业务的加密货币创始人而言具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: The role of green financing in facilitating renewable energy transition in China: Perspectives from energy governance, environmental regulation, and market reforms
articles.title_cn: 绿色融资在中国可再生能源转型中的作用：能源治理、环境规制与市场改革的视角
articles.abstract_en: Green financing plays an important role in providing adequate support for environmentally sustainable projects aimed at reducing China's reliance on fossil fuels. At the same time, targeted government policies can facilitate green financial development, helping promote renewable energy transition. We add to the debate on the link between green finance and clean energy consumption as well as explore the exact transmission mechanisms underlying this nexus. Our empirical illustration is based on a generalized method of moments (GMM) specification of a panel threshold regression model and a sample of 30 Chinese provinces from 2001 to 2019. We find that green financing initiatives have helped accelerate the transformation of China's energy industry by promoting an increase in the share of renewable energy in its overall fuel mix, especially in regions with relatively well-functioning markets. Several robustness tests confirm the existence of this relationship. Moreover, our results suggest that improved energy efficiency governance and environmental regulation positively moderate the impact of green finance on clean energy transition. Our study provides policymakers with insights on how improved governance, environmental protection initiatives, and market reforms can foster the development of China's green financial market and help reduce its current dependence on dirty energy.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色融资在为旨在减少中国对化石燃料依赖的环境可持续项目提供充分支持方面发挥着重要作用。同时，有针对性的政府政策可以促进绿色金融发展，有助于推动可再生能源转型。我们加入了关于绿色金融与清洁能源消费之间联系的讨论，并探讨了这一关系背后的确切传导机制。我们的实证分析基于广义矩估计（GMM）的面板阈值回归模型规范，以及2001年至2019年间中国30个省份的样本。我们发现，绿色融资举措通过促进可再生能源在整体能源结构中份额的增加，加速了中国能源行业的转型，尤其是在市场运行相对良好的地区。多项稳健性检验证实了这一关系的存在。此外，我们的结果表明，能源效率治理和环境规制的改善正向调节了绿色金融对清洁能源转型的影响。我们的研究为政策制定者提供了关于改善治理、环境保护举措和市场改革如何促进中国绿色金融市场发展并帮助减少当前对高污染能源依赖的见解。

articles.title_en: Electricity production, power generation structure, and air pollution: A monthly data analysis for 279 cities in China (2015–2019)
articles.title_cn: 电力生产、发电结构与空气污染：基于中国279个城市的月度数据分析（2015-2019）
articles.abstract_en: Advancing the clean transition of energy structure and reducing air pollution levels are important actions for achieving sustainable urban development. In this study, we analyze the impact of power production and structure on urban air pollution by analyzing the monthly power generation data of 14,570 power plants in 279 prefecture-level cities from January 2015 to December 2019. These data were matched with social, economic, and resource panel data. The study confirmed the positive impact of the increasing proportion of renewable energy on air pollution mitigation, especially when the proportion of renewable power supply exceeds 28.22%. This positive impact has a significant spatial spillover effect, with more air quality improvement seen in East, Central, Southwest, and Northwest China. By designing installation development scenarios for renewable energy, this paper projects the air pollution in major regions of China in 2030. The projection indicates that the PM2.5 concentration in each region could be lower than 35 μg/m3, but the overall proportion of photoelectric and wind power in the primary energy supply remains small. This highlights the need to increase the mitigation of urban air pollution further, by stimulating the innovation of power generation technology, improving power generation efficiency, and encouraging the large-scale development of renewable energy.
articles.abstract_cn: 推进能源结构清洁转型和降低空气污染水平是实现城市可持续发展的重要举措。本研究通过分析2015年一月至2019年十二月中国279个地级市中14,570座发电厂的月度发电数据，探讨电力生产及其结构对城市空气污染的影响。这些数据与社会、经济和资源面板数据相匹配。研究证实了可再生能源占比提高对空气污染缓解的积极作用，尤其是当可再生能源供电比例超过28.22%时，这种积极影响更为显著。该积极影响具有显著的空间溢出效应，东部、中部、西南和西北地区的空气质量改善更为明显。通过设计可再生能源的装机发展情景，本文预测了2030年中国主要地区的空气污染状况。预测结果显示，各地区的PM2.5浓度可能低于35微克/立方米，但光电和风电在一次能源供应中的总体占比仍然较小。这表明需要进一步加大城市空气污染的缓解力度，通过激发发电技术创新、提高发电效率以及鼓励可再生能源的大规模发展来实现。

articles.title_en: The environmental pillar of ESG and financial performance: A portfolio analysis
articles.title_cn: ESG的环境支柱与财务绩效：一项投资组合分析
articles.abstract_en: Our research uses the environmental pillar of ESG as a proxy for environmental corporate social responsibility. We examine the performance of environmentally clustered portfolios by using simple quantitative investment strategies with optimum asset rotation. Post-hoc, sample-split analysis with non-parametric tests is performed. The results suggest that both environmental status and dynamic environmental performance are key characteristics of divergent financial behaviors. We show that environmentally low-rated companies present better financial performance, while environmental leaders are less risky and show more resilience. Assets with a dynamic environmental profile outperform on average in terms of returns and risk. Furthermore, supporting evidence of positive spillovers in high-rated environmental clusters is identified after the Paris Agreement. We evaluate the resilience of the environmental clusters during the COVID-19 crisis and the Russia-Ukraine war effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们的研究将ESG的环境支柱作为企业环境社会责任的代理指标。我们通过使用具有最优资产轮动的简单量化投资策略，检验环境聚类投资组合的表现。事后，我们进行了带有非参数检验的样本分割分析。结果表明，环境状况和动态环境绩效都是财务行为分化的关键特征。我们显示，环境评级较低的公司表现出更好的财务绩效，而环境领导者风险较低且更具韧性。具有动态环境特征的资产在收益和风险方面平均表现更优。此外，在《巴黎协定》之后，我们识别出高评级环境聚类中存在正向溢出的支持证据。我们评估了环境聚类在COVID-19危机和俄乌战争影响期间的韧性。

articles.title_en: Reducing information barriers to solar adoption: Experimental evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 减少太阳能采用的信息障碍：来自印度的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Off-grid solar technologies hold promise for unelectrified and low-quality electricity settings; however, their adoption remains low. Important barriers to adoption, such as incomplete information remain relatively unexplored in developing countries. In collaboration with a solar company, a randomized experiment was implemented in three Indian states to test whether alleviating information asymmetries between sales agents and potential customers improved predictors and other indicators of adoption of solar rooftop systems. The company’s sales agents were randomly assigned to receive a tablet with either an application designed to ensure potential customers received accurate solar product information during the sales process or only the basic sales catalogue uploaded. Post-treatment, prospective customers approached by the treated sales agents report greater knowledge of the solar products and a better impression of sales agents’ product knowledge and professionalism. The treatment significantly increased potential customers’ intent-to-adopt, a stated preference measure, by 15%; however, the impact on actual adoption was statistically insignificant.
articles.abstract_cn: 离网太阳能技术对于未通电和低质量电力环境具有前景；然而，其采用率仍然较低。采用的重要障碍，如信息不完整，在发展中国家相对未被探索。与一家太阳能公司合作，在印度三个邦实施了一项随机实验，以检验缓解销售代理与潜在客户之间的信息不对称是否能改善太阳能屋顶系统采用的预测指标和其他指标。公司的销售代理被随机分配获得一台平板电脑，其中包含一个旨在确保潜在客户在销售过程中获得准确太阳能产品信息的应用程序，或者仅包含基本销售目录。处理后，由处理组销售代理接触的潜在客户报告对太阳能产品有更多了解，并对销售代理的产品知识和专业性有更好的印象。该处理显著增加了潜在客户的采用意向（一种陈述性偏好指标），增加了15%；然而，对实际采用的影响在统计上不显著。

articles.title_en: Assessing the impact of battery storage on Australian electricity markets
articles.title_cn: 评估电池储能对澳大利亚电力市场的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper empirically examines the impacts of grid-scale battery storage facilities on the frequency control ancillary services (FCAS) market that is used by energy market operators to maintain the frequency of the system within the normal operating band. Using a staggered introduction of grid-scale batteries in two Australian states, our difference-in-differences analysis shows that grid-scale batteries can significantly lower overall FCAS costs. We further show that the reduced FCAS costs are accentuated by the battery storage capacity, and that their impacts are most pronounced in reducing the costs of short-term FCAS markets (such as the regulation and 6-second services). These FCAS markets typically displace more expensive fossil-fuel participation. Given the large scale of both battery and renewable adoption in Australia, our results have policy implications for global energy markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文实证研究了电网规模电池储能设施对频率控制辅助服务（FCAS）市场的影响，该市场由能源市场运营商用于将系统频率维持在正常运营频带内。利用澳大利亚两个州电网规模电池的分阶段引入，我们的双重差分分析表明，电网规模电池可以显著降低整体FCAS成本。我们进一步表明，降低的FCAS成本因电池储能容量而加剧，并且其影响在降低短期FCAS市场（如调节和6秒服务）成本方面最为显著。这些FCAS市场通常取代更昂贵的化石燃料参与。鉴于澳大利亚电池和可再生能源采用规模庞大，我们的结果对全球能源市场具有政策意义。

articles.title_en: From point forecasts to multivariate probabilistic forecasts: The Schaake shuffle for day-ahead electricity price forecasting
articles.title_cn: 从点预测到多元概率预测：日前电价预测中的Schaake洗牌法
articles.abstract_en: Modeling price risks is crucial for economic decision making in energy markets. Besides the risk associated with a single price, the dependence structure of multiple prices is often relevant. We therefore propose a generic and easy-to-implement method for generating multivariate probabilistic forecasts based on univariate point forecasts of day-ahead electricity prices. While each univariate point forecast refers to one of the day’s 24 hours, the multivariate forecast distribution models dependencies across hours. The proposed method is based on simple copula techniques and an optional time series component. We illustrate the method for five benchmark data sets. Furthermore, we demonstrate an example for constructing realistic prediction intervals for the weighted sum of consecutive electricity prices as needed for pricing individual load profiles.
articles.abstract_cn: 对价格风险进行建模对于能源市场中的经济决策至关重要。除了与单一价格相关的风险外，多个价格之间的依赖结构也常常是相关的。因此，我们提出了一种通用且易于实现的方法，基于日前电价的单变量点预测来生成多元概率预测。虽然每个单变量点预测对应一天中的24个小时之一，但多元预测分布则对小时之间的依赖关系进行建模。所提出的方法基于简单的copula技术和一个可选的时间序列成分。我们通过五个基准数据集对该方法进行了说明。此外，我们展示了一个示例，用于构建连续电价加权和的现实预测区间，这对于单个负荷曲线的定价是必需的。

articles.title_en: Forecasting oil inventory changes with Google trends: A hybrid wavelet decomposer and ARDL-SVR ensemble model
articles.title_cn: 利用谷歌趋势预测石油库存变化：一种小波分解器与ARDL-SVR混合集成模型
articles.abstract_en: The current crude oil inventory is still at a historical high, and the destocking of crude oil has become a long-term pattern. In the context that changes in crude oil inventories have attracted much attention from the market, a hybrid Wavelet-ARDL-SVR (WAS) model is proposed to predict the change in the oil inventory.11The abbreviations and definitions of field-specific terms used in the paper are shown in Appendix A. First, this paper constructs a new indicator to express the correlation between investor behavior and inventory through Google Trends. Then, aiming at the problem that the relationships between inventory and influencing factors are not significant in the time domain, the application of wavelet finds the driving factors and frequency characteristics of inventory changes. We innovatively find that the buffering effect of inventory is reflected in the long-term, while the speculation effect is mainly superimposed in the short-term, especially the speculation on the supply side is more likely to cause market risks. Finally, the empirical results show that the proposed method provides better prediction accuracy. Especially, it improves sign consistency by 19% compared to the predictions of the research institution.
articles.abstract_cn: 当前原油库存仍处于历史高位，原油去库存已成为长期趋势。在原油库存变化备受市场关注的背景下，本文提出了一种混合小波-ARDL-SVR（WAS）模型来预测石油库存变化。首先，本文通过谷歌趋势构建了一个新指标，用以表达投资者行为与库存之间的相关性。然后，针对库存与影响因素之间关系在时域上不显著的问题，应用小波方法发现了库存变化的驱动因素和频率特征。我们创新性地发现，库存的缓冲效应体现在长期，而投机效应主要叠加在短期，尤其是供应侧的投机更易引发市场风险。最后，实证结果表明，所提方法提供了更好的预测精度。特别是，与研究机构的预测相比，符号一致性提高了19%。

articles.title_en: Information spillovers between carbon emissions trading prices and shipping markets: A time-frequency analysis
articles.title_cn: 碳排放交易价格与航运市场之间的信息溢出：时频分析
articles.abstract_en: Climate change has become mankind's main challenge. Greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from shipping are not totally irresponsible for this representing, roughly, 3% of the global total; an amount equal to that of Germany's total GHG emissions. The Fourth Greenhouse Gas Study 2020 of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) predicts that the share of GHG emissions from shipping will increase further, as international trade recovers and continues to grow, alongside with the economic development of India, China, and Africa. China and the European Union have proposed to include shipping in their carbon emissions trading systems (ETS). As a result, the study of the relationship between the carbon finance market and the shipping industry, attempted here for the first time, is both important and timely, both for policymakers and shipowners. We use wavelet analysis and the spillover index methods to explore the dynamic dependence and information spillovers between the carbon finance market and shipping. We discover a long-term dependence and information linkages between the two markets, with the carbon finance market being the dominant one. Major events, such as the 2009 global financial crisis; Brexit in 2016; the 2018 China-US trade frictions; and COVID-19 are shown to strengthen the dependence of carbon finance and shipping. We find that the dependence is strongest between the EU carbon finance market and dry bulk shipping, while the link is weaker in the case of tanker shipping. Nonetheless, carbon finance and tanker shipping showed a relatively stronger dependence when OPEC refused to cut production in 2014, and when the China-US trade disputes led to the collapse of oil prices after 2018. We show that information spillovers between carbon finance and shipping are bidirectional and asymmetric, with the carbon finance market being the principal transmitter of information. Our results and their interpretation provide guidance to governments on whether (and how) to include shipping in emissions trading schemes, supporting at the same time the environmental sustainability decisions of shipping companies.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化已成为人类面临的主要挑战。航运产生的温室气体（GHG）排放对此并非毫无责任，约占全球总量的3%；这一数量相当于德国温室气体排放总量。国际海事组织（IMO）的第四次温室气体研究（2020年）预测，随着国际贸易复苏并持续增长，以及印度、中国和非洲的经济发展，航运温室气体排放的份额将进一步增加。中国和欧盟已提议将航运纳入其碳排放交易体系（ETS）。因此，首次尝试研究碳金融市场与航运业之间的关系，对政策制定者和船东而言既重要又及时。我们使用小波分析和溢出指数方法，探讨碳金融市场与航运之间的动态依赖性和信息溢出。我们发现两个市场之间存在长期依赖性和信息联系，其中碳金融市场占主导地位。重大事件，如2009年全球金融危机；2016年英国脱欧；2018年中美贸易摩擦；以及COVID-19，均显示出加强了碳金融与航运之间的依赖性。我们发现，欧盟碳金融市场与干散货航运之间的依赖性最强，而油轮航运的联系则较弱。尽管如此，在2014年OPEC拒绝减产以及2018年后中美贸易争端导致油价暴跌时，碳金融与油轮航运表现出相对较强的依赖性。我们表明，碳金融与航运之间的信息溢出是双向且不对称的，碳金融市场是信息的主要传递者。我们的结果及其解释为政府是否以及如何将航运纳入排放交易计划提供了指导，同时支持航运公司的环境可持续性决策。

articles.title_en: The US-China trade war and the volatility linkages between energy and agricultural commodities
articles.title_cn: 中美贸易战与能源和农产品之间的波动性联动
articles.abstract_en: Any disruptive changes in the competitive environment, such as the U.S.-China trade war, may influence the price volatility of crude oil and agricultural commodities. This study examines the volatility linkage between crude oil and agricultural commodity markets in the context of the U.S.-China trade war and compares the impact of the trade war with that of other exogenous shocks. The results show that the volatility of soybeans exhibits the highest level of responsiveness to the U.S.-China trade war - which is not surprising given that the U.S. agribusiness trade to China is dominated by soybeans - followed by coffee and cotton. The sizes and dynamics of the impacts of shocks are largely commodity-specific. Notably, the trade war impacts most agricultural commodities more extensively than other exogenous shocks, including the global financial crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic and associated recession. These findings matter not only for the decision-making of investors and portfolio managers but also for commodity-exporting and importing countries because changes in the volatility dynamics of crude oil and agricultural commodities often impact export revenues and import expenditures and consequently feed through exports to the global supply chain under exogenous shocks such as the U.S.-China trade war.
articles.abstract_cn: 竞争环境中的任何破坏性变化，如中美贸易战，都可能影响原油和农产品的价格波动。本研究考察了中美贸易战背景下原油与农产品市场之间的波动性联动，并将贸易战的影响与其他外生冲击的影响进行了比较。结果表明，大豆的波动性对中美贸易战的反应程度最高——鉴于美国对华农业贸易以大豆为主，这并不令人意外——其次是咖啡和棉花。冲击影响的大小和动态在很大程度上具有商品特异性。值得注意的是，贸易战对大多数农产品的影响比其他外生冲击（包括全球金融危机和COVID-19大流行及其相关的衰退）更为广泛。这些发现不仅对投资者和投资组合经理的决策具有重要意义，而且对商品出口国和进口国也具有重要意义，因为在诸如中美贸易战等外生冲击下，原油和农产品波动动态的变化往往会影响出口收入和进口支出，并进而通过出口传导至全球供应链。

articles.title_en: Sustainable debt and gas markets: A new look using the time-varying wavelet-windowed cross-correlation approach
articles.title_cn: 可持续债务与天然气市场：基于时变小波窗口互相关方法的新视角
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the time-varying interactive linkages between the sustainable debt market and gas markets, applying unique estimation techniques, specifically the empirical mode decomposition (EMD)-windowed-cross-correlation (EMD-WCC) and wavelet-windowed-cross-correlations. To this end, we use the S&P Green Bond Index as a representative of a sustainable debt market while for the gas market, we use natural gas price indices of UK NBP (National Balancing Point), NYMEX HH (Henry Hub) and US shale gas prices. The lead/lag behavior amid green-bonds along with shale gas, also with natural gas markets has equal forces across all time scales. There exists weak cross-correlation across green bonds and shale gas markets and additionally, green bonds and natural gas markets in the short-run. Such findings imply that, from the perspective of the investors, in the short-run, green bonds have ample diversification benefits. The highest intensity of cross-correlations is observed in the longer time horizons. This evidence suggests that in the long-run the behavior of the markets is driven by its own peculiarities. Overall, our findings support the argument that green bonds with their climate-friendly properties add to the diversification benefits for investors, as a newer class of asset for portfolio investments.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文运用独特的估计技术，即经验模态分解-窗口互相关（EMD-WCC）和小波窗口互相关，考察了可持续债务市场与天然气市场之间的时变互动联系。为此，我们使用标普绿色债券指数作为可持续债务市场的代表，而天然气市场则采用英国NBP（国家平衡点）、NYMEX HH（亨利港）和美国页岩气价格的天然气价格指数。绿色债券与页岩气以及天然气市场之间的领先/滞后行为在所有时间尺度上具有相同的力量。在短期内，绿色债券与页岩气市场以及绿色债券与天然气市场之间存在弱互相关。这些发现意味着，从投资者的角度来看，短期内绿色债券具有充分的分散化收益。在较长的时间范围内观察到最高强度的互相关。这一证据表明，长期内市场行为由其自身特性驱动。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持了绿色债券凭借其气候友好特性，作为投资组合中的新型资产类别，为投资者增加了分散化收益的论点。

articles.title_en: Examining crude oil price outlook amidst substitute energy price and household energy expenditure in the USA: A novel nonparametric multivariate QQR approach
articles.title_cn: 审视替代能源价格与家庭能源支出背景下的美国原油价格前景：一种新颖的非参数多元分位数对分位数方法
articles.abstract_en: The outlook of crude oil prices has sparsely been empirically examined especially from the critical perspectives of energy expenditure per household, retail electricity prices, and environmental indicators. Given the enormous macroeconomic and socioeconomic effects of crude oil price amidst the fundamentals, this study examines the dynamics of the oil price outlook amidst energy demand (measured by energy expenditure per household), retail electricity price i.e., substitute price, and carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions in the United States of America (USA) over the period 1970 to 2040. This study offers two main innovations: first, it extends the bivariate nonparametric Quantile-on-Quantile Regression (QQR) to the multivariate case. Second, the analysis incorporates projected data series, which provides useful policy insights. The empirical results show evidence of time-varying effects of energy expenditure per household, retail electricity price, and CO2 emissions across the quantiles of crude energy prices. The results further show that the effect of energy demand through household energy expenditures is positive and stronger at the lower quantiles of crude oil price, which corresponds to periods of low crude oil prices. Furthermore, the effects of retail electricity price and CO2 emissions are negative and stronger in the mid-quantiles of crude oil price. This suggests that retail electricity prices and environmental indicator dampen crude oil prices during periods of low crude oil prices. These findings are robust to multivariate Quantile regression and Kernel-based Regularized Least Squares (KRLS) estimates. Therefore, our study suggests time-varying policies to dampen the effects of energy demand, retail electricity price, and environmental indicator on crude oil prices in the USA.
articles.abstract_cn: 原油价格的前景很少从家庭能源支出、零售电价和环境指标等关键角度进行实证检验。鉴于原油价格在基本面因素中的巨大宏观经济和社会经济影响，本研究考察了1970年至2040年期间美利坚合众国（美国）能源需求（以家庭能源支出衡量）、零售电价（即替代价格）和二氧化碳（CO2）排放背景下的原油价格前景动态。本研究提供两项主要创新：首先，将双变量非参数分位数对分位数回归（QQR）扩展到多元情形。其次，分析纳入了预测数据序列，这提供了有用的政策见解。实证结果显示，家庭能源支出、零售电价和CO2排放对原油价格各分位数的影响存在时变效应。结果进一步表明，通过家庭能源支出衡量的能源需求效应在原油价格较低分位数处为正且更强，这对应于原油价格较低的时期。此外，零售电价和CO2排放的影响在原油价格中位数分位数处为负且更强。这表明零售电价和环境指标在原油价格较低时期抑制了原油价格。这些发现对多元分位数回归和基于核的正则化最小二乘（KRLS）估计具有稳健性。因此，我们的研究建议采取时变政策，以抑制能源需求、零售电价和环境指标对美国原油价格的影响。

articles.title_en: Network Regulation under electoral competition
articles.title_cn: 选举竞争下的网络监管
articles.abstract_en: Academics and policymakers generally agree that energy infrastructure should be subject to price regulation. More and more critics of modern regulatory approaches, however, point to the apparent failures of these mechanisms to achieve competitive pricing in practice. Some have suggested that customers ought to be involved in the regulatory process, but it is uncertain how customers' perspectives can best be incorporated. In this study, we evaluate how electoral competition influences monopoly pricing by extending well-known regulatory laboratory experiments. We show that electoral competition has a significant and negative impact on prices. This effect disappears when electoral competition is implemented jointly with incentive regulation, implying substitutability rather than complementarity of regulation and electoral competition.
articles.abstract_cn: 学者和政策制定者普遍认为，能源基础设施应受到价格监管。然而，越来越多的现代监管方法批评者指出，这些机制在实践中未能实现竞争性定价的明显失败。一些人建议客户应参与监管过程，但尚不确定如何最好地纳入客户的观点。在本研究中，我们通过扩展著名的监管实验室实验来评估选举竞争如何影响垄断定价。我们表明，选举竞争对价格有显著且负面的影响。当选举竞争与激励性监管共同实施时，这种效应消失，这意味着监管与选举竞争之间存在替代性而非互补性。

articles.title_en: The carrot and the stock: In search of stock-market incentives for decarbonization
articles.title_cn: 胡萝卜与股票：探寻股市对脱碳的激励
articles.abstract_en: Financial markets can support the transition to a low-carbon economy by redirecting funds from highly emissive to clean investments. We study whether European stock markets take carbon prices into account in company valuations and to what degree they discriminate between firms with different carbon intensities. Using a novel dataset containing stock prices and carbon intensities of 338 European publicly traded companies between 2013 and 2021, we find a strongly statistically significant relationship between weekly carbon price changes and stock returns. Crucially, this relationship depends on firms’ carbon intensity: the higher the carbon costs a firm faces, the poorer its stock performance during the periods of carbon price increases. Emissions that firms cover with free allowances however do not impact this relationship, illustrating how, in the absence of carbon pricing, data disclosure alone might not be sufficient for financial markets to support climate change mitigation. The relationship we identify can provide an incentive for firms to decarbonize. We argue in favor of more ambitious carbon pricing policies, as this would strengthen the stock-market incentive channel.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融市场可以通过将资金从高排放投资转向清洁投资来支持向低碳经济的转型。我们研究欧洲股票市场是否在公司估值中考虑碳价格，以及它们在多大程度上区分不同碳强度的公司。使用一个包含2013年至2021年间338家欧洲上市公司股票价格和碳强度的新数据集，我们发现每周碳价格变化与股票回报之间存在强烈的统计显著关系。关键在于，这种关系取决于公司的碳强度：公司面临的碳成本越高，在碳价格上升期间其股票表现越差。然而，公司通过免费配额覆盖的排放并不影响这种关系，这表明在没有碳定价的情况下，仅靠数据披露可能不足以让金融市场支持减缓气候变化。我们识别出的这种关系可以为公司提供脱碳的激励。我们主张采取更雄心勃勃的碳定价政策，因为这将加强股市的激励渠道。

articles.title_en: Modelling Australian electricity prices using indicator saturation
articles.title_cn: 使用指示器饱和法建模澳大利亚电价
articles.abstract_en: In our analysis of electricity price series from Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM), we employ the indicator saturation (IS) approach to simultaneously model the stylised facts of electricity prices, including extreme spikes, seasonality, level-shifts, and autocorrelation. The standard modelling methods described in the literature tend to use regime-switching models to cope with these characteristics, but these models cannot fully reflect the stylised facts of interest. Using a range of model-evaluation tools, our analysis finds that the IS method outperforms the regime-switching models in various settings. In addition to the statistical superiority of this approach, we detail the relevance of our findings to policymaking in the NEM and provide recommendations for the development of the electricity markets in Australia.
articles.abstract_cn: 在我们对澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）电价序列的分析中，我们采用指示器饱和（IS）方法同时建模电价的典型事实，包括极端尖峰、季节性、水平位移和自相关。文献中描述的标准建模方法倾向于使用机制转换模型来应对这些特征，但这些模型无法充分反映所关注的典型事实。通过一系列模型评估工具，我们的分析发现IS方法在各种设定下优于机制转换模型。除了该方法在统计上的优越性外，我们还详细阐述了我们的发现对NEM政策制定的相关性，并为澳大利亚电力市场的发展提供了建议。

articles.title_en: The effect of oil implied volatility and geopolitical risk on GCC stock sectors under various market conditions
articles.title_cn: 不同市场条件下石油隐含波动率和地缘政治风险对海湾合作委员会股票板块的影响
articles.abstract_en: The importance of crude oil volatility and geopolitical risk for stock pricing is well known in both developed and emerging economies, but is relatively understudied in major oil-exporting countries at the sectoral level of stock indices and under various market conditions. Using daily data on eight Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) stock sector indices over the period February 2010–30 June 2022, we capture the effect of two global risk factors, namely oil implied volatility and geopolitical risk, on stock returns and volatility while accounting for bull/bear markets and low/high volatility regimes. The analysis indicates the following results. Firstly, the effect of oil implied volatility is stronger than that of geopolitical risk, notably for Consumer Discretionary and Staples. Secondly, the effect on both returns and volatility is generally positive during bull markets, but it is stronger for volatility; the response of the returns of Energy, Materials, Industrials, and Financials is negative in bear markets and positive during bull markets. Thirdly, the effect of oil implied volatility on stock sector volatility is slightly higher during the COVID-19 outbreak for some cases and is prominent during bull markets. Our findings matter for the predictability of GCC stock sector returns and volatility and for the design of hedging strategies under various market states.
articles.abstract_cn: 原油波动和地缘政治风险对股票定价的重要性在发达经济体和新兴经济体中众所周知，但在主要石油出口国，在股票指数的部门层面和各种市场条件下，其研究相对不足。利用二月2010-30六月2022期间八个海湾合作委员会（GCC）股票板块指数的每日数据，我们捕捉了两个全球风险因素（即石油隐含波动率和地缘政治风险）对股票回报和波动率的影响，同时考虑了牛市/熊市和低/高波动率制度。分析表明以下结果。首先，石油隐含波动率的影响强于地缘政治风险，尤其是对非必需消费品和必需品的影响。其次，在牛市期间，对回报和波动性的影响通常都是正的，但对波动性的影响更大；能源、材料、工业和金融股的回报率在熊市时为负值，在牛市时为正值。第三，在某些情况下，石油隐含波动率对股市波动率的影响在新冠肺炎19爆发期间略高，并且在牛市期间更为突出。我们的研究结果对于海湾合作委员会股票行业回报和波动性的可预测性以及各种市场状态下对冲策略的设计至关重要。

articles.title_en: A threshold effect of COVID-19 risk on oil price returns
articles.title_cn: COVID-19风险对石油价格收益的阈值效应
articles.abstract_en: Using U.S. data, we investigate how the COVID-19 pandemic influences oil price returns in an asset pricing framework. Unlike earlier studies, we consider a threshold model to allow for the possibility that COVID-19 risk may not play a role until it reaches a certain level. Based on WTI crude oil spot price data from January 2020 to December 2021, our findings show that oil returns significantly decline with the daily number of COVID-19 deaths but only if the daily death toll exceeds approximately 2100. In addition, a more severe COVID-19 pandemic can substantially increase the exposure of oil returns to various systematic risk factors, which has not been documented in previous literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用美国数据，我们在资产定价框架下研究了COVID-19疫情如何影响石油价格收益。与早期研究不同，我们考虑了一个阈值模型，以允许COVID-19风险在达到一定水平之前可能不起作用的可能性。基于2020年一月至2021年十二月的WTI原油现货价格数据，我们的研究结果表明，石油收益随着每日COVID-19死亡人数的增加而显著下降，但仅在每日死亡人数超过约2100人时如此。此外，更严重的COVID-19疫情可以显著增加石油收益对各种系统性风险因素的暴露，这一点在以往的文献中尚未被记录。

articles.title_en: The role of China's crude oil futures in world oil futures market and China's financial market
articles.title_cn: 中国原油期货在世界原油期货市场及中国金融市场中的作用
articles.abstract_en: China's crude oil futures (COF) denominated in RMB were formally launched in 2018 and traded in the Shanghai International Exchange (INE), which was an important milestone in China's energy financialization. Combining TVP-VAR method and DY spillover index, this paper firstly studied the information spillover relationship between the world's major COF and crude oil spot (COS) markets before and after the launch of China's COF. It is found that China's COF mainly play the role of net information receiver in world COF/COS market, and its influence in international market and price discovery function needs to be improved. Further, this paper comprehensively considered China's financial system, taking volatility of financial time series as risk proxy to investigate the risk spillover effect. The results show that the financial attributes of China's COF have become prominent. The dynamic analysis shows that since the launch of China's COF, the degree of its net spillover to other markets has generally been on the decrease, assuming a net risk transmitter role. On this basis, this paper puts forward policy recommendations to promote the development of China's COF.
articles.abstract_cn: 以人民币计价的中国原油期货（COF）于2018年正式在上海国际能源交易中心（INE）上市交易，这是中国能源金融化的重要里程碑。本文结合TVP-VAR方法和DY溢出指数，首先研究了中国原油期货上市前后世界主要原油期货与原油现货（COS）市场之间的信息溢出关系。研究发现，中国原油期货在世界原油期货/现货市场中主要扮演净信息接收者的角色，其在国际市场中的影响力和价格发现功能有待提升。进一步，本文综合考虑中国金融体系，以金融时间序列的波动性作为风险代理指标，考察风险溢出效应。结果表明，中国原油期货的金融属性已变得突出。动态分析显示，自中国原油期货上市以来，其对其他市场的净溢出程度总体呈下降趋势，承担着净风险传递者的角色。在此基础上，本文提出了促进中国原油期货发展的政策建议。

articles.title_en: Using machine learning to select variables in data envelopment analysis: Simulations and application using electricity distribution data
articles.title_cn: 使用机器学习在数据包络分析中选择变量：基于电力配送数据的模拟与应用
articles.abstract_en: Agencies that regulate electricity providers often apply nonparametric data envelopment analysis (DEA) to assess the relative efficiency of each firm. The reliability and validity of DEA are contingent upon selecting relevant input variables. In the era of big (wide) data, the assumptions of traditional variable selection techniques are often violated due to challenges related to high-dimensional data and their standard empirical properties.
